concept.title: Run CSSMedia
concept.shortdesc: Run CSSMedia from the command line with an XML file, a CSS file and the name of the PDF to write.

conbody.p: This command generates a PDF from your XML and your stylesheet:
If you built CSSMedia from source and did not install it globally, run node dist/cssmedia.js instead of cssmedia.
Running CSSMedia without parameters displays this help:
conbody.pre:
Usage: cssmedia -x <file> -c <file> -p <file> [-f <fontsFolder>] [-g <catalog>]
-x, --xml <file> XML file to format -c, --css <file> CSS stylesheet to apply -p, --pdf <file> PDF file to write -f, --fonts <folder> (optional) alternative fonts folder -g, --catalog <file> (optional) OASIS catalog to use when parsing XML
conbody.p: Use -f to pass a fonts folder that you reuse from any project. Use -g to pass an OASIS Catalog when your XML refers to grammars.

When something in the XML or the stylesheet cannot be used, for example an image that cannot be read, CSSMedia still writes the PDF and prints a warning for each problem after the run. If a file is missing or an error stops the run, CSSMedia prints the error and does not write the PDF.
